title: Terms of Use | BettaFish.website
description: Terms governing educational use of BettaFish.website and its external resources.
intro: BettaFish.website provides general educational information about fish husbandry. It is not an individualized veterinary service.

sections.heading: Educational information
paragraphs: Readers remain responsible for decisions about their animals and should consider the fish's actual condition, water tests, product instructions and professional advice.
Online information cannot examine an animal, confirm a diagnosis or account for every local product formulation and legal requirement.

sections.heading: Accuracy and availability
paragraphs: The site aims to correct material errors and review time-sensitive guidance, but it cannot promise that every page will remain complete or available without interruption.
External links are provided for context and do not imply control over another site's content, availability or privacy practices.

sections.heading: Legal review pending
sections.text: The final terms require owner identity and jurisdiction review before production launch.
